---
name: 'review-rainfocus-ui'
description: 'Review or fix a RainFocus UI change for behavior, responsive layout, themes, density, accessibility, design fidelity, browser rendering, tests, and delivery.'
argument-hint: '<review only or review and fix; changed files or UI concern; expected behavior; affected viewports/themes/densities>'
agent: 'rainfocus-ui-reviewer'
---

Review the RainFocus UI scope provided with this prompt.

Preserve whether the request is **review only** or **review and fix**. Establish the changed files or observed concern, expected behavior, affected interactions and responsive states, and available design evidence before acting. Use repository evidence and rendered behavior, keep changes within the supplied scope, and return findings and validation in the format required by the selected agent.
